blocks.content: A reducer solves the problem by centralizing all state change logic in one place.
Instead of saying "here is the new state", you say "here is what happened." You describe the event (the action), and a pure function decides what the new state looks like.
The shape of a reducer is always the same.

items: action is an object that describes what happened.
The return value becomes the new state.
